name: AI Mode Plugin for FPP
author: jessica12ryan
description: Configure and control Falcon Player (FPP) using natural language via major AI platforms — now with voice input. Link OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Mistral, Grok, OpenRouter, Ollama and more with API tokens to create playlists, schedules, channel outputs and settings from typed or spoken prompts. Includes conversational assistant with browser voice transcription, tool-calling execution with approval, and full FPP API coverage.

privacy.summary: Sends prompts and FPP context to your chosen AI provider to generate config actions. Voice is transcribed in-browser; only text is sent. Nothing sent unless you click Send.
